scripts.lint:all: pnpm --filter @riotworks/ui run lint & pnpm --filter @riotworks/arsy run lint & pnpm --filter @riotworks/types run lint & pnpm --filter @riotworks/arsy-core run lint & pnpm --filter @riotworks/headquarter run lint
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm --filter @riotworks/ui run type-check & pnpm --filter @riotworks/arsy run type-check & pnpm --filter @riotworks/arsy-core run type-check & pnpm --filter @riotworks/contract run type-check & pnpm --filter @riotworks/types run type-check & pnpm --filter @riotworks/lint run type-check & pnpm --filter @riotworks/headquarter run type-check
scripts.check:repo: pnpm run lockfile:check && pnpm run validate:repo
scripts.audit:repo: pnpm run lockfile:check && pnpm run validate:repo
scripts.validate:repo: pnpm run lockfile:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run type-check
scripts.validate: pnpm run validate:repo && pnpm run build
